headline: GW 1 CROWN: MARVE MATHINGU CLAIMS SUPREME GLORY AS MARVIN OWINO ANCHORS THE CLOWN CAR!
subheadline: Official Issue #1: Masterclass at the summit, carnage at the bottom, and an unfiltered autopsy of the weekend.
weather_report: Clear skies at the top of the table. Relegation zone experiencing severe thunder and tactical depression.
editorial_lead: Welcome to Issue #1 of The FPL Boys Gazette! Gameweek 1 kicked off with high drama and tactical showdowns across all 10 managers. Leading from the front, Marve Mathingu (Marve of the Match) put on a championship display, amassing a league-high 61 points to secure top honors and pocket Ksh. 250.00 in prize money. However, for every champion standing proudly on the podium, there is a casualty in the trenches. At the very bottom of the table, Marvin Owino (Don Bosco) suffered a complete tactical meltdown with only 36 points, officially earning the unwanted wooden spoon. Read through the full breakdown below for the complete manager-by-manager autopsy!
clown_reason: Marvin Owino collapsed to rank #9 with just 36 points. A textbook disasterclass that will be studied in tactical defense academies as what NOT to do.
king_reason: Marve Mathingu dominated the round with 61 net points, bagging Ksh. 250.00. An imperious showing that sets the early benchmark for the rest of the league to chase!
quote_of_the_week: "My rank is only temporary. By Gameweek 38, they will see the vision." — Marvin Owino
defaulter_roast: 🚨 LEAGUE GRACE PERIOD (GW 1): The League Committee has officially declared a full grace period for GW 1 & GW 2! Zero late penalty fines apply for all managers. Defaulters get a clean slate for the opening fortnight—strict Ksh. 50 fines will be enforced by the Treasurer starting GW 3!
transfer_hit_roast: Season Kickoff Window: All 10 managers launched with unlimited free squad selections prior to the GW 1 deadline. Point-deducting transfer hits unlock from GW 2 onward, where panic transfers and tactical chaos will officially commence!

manager_roasts.roast_title: Marve Mathingu - Truly The 'Marve of the Match'
manager_roasts.roast_body: Living up to his team name with supreme swagger, Marve delivered the ultimate masterclass with 61 points. Sits proudly atop the 10-man summit and banks Ksh. 250.00.
manager_roasts.verdict: Verdict: Certified Marve of the Match & Cash King

manager_roasts.roast_title: Samuel Wambua - 'maggry shiners' Bag The Podium Cash
manager_roasts.roast_body: Samuel's 'maggry shiners fc' shone under the lights with 56 points, clinching 🥈 place and Ksh. 166.67.

manager_roasts.roast_title: Renny Muragu - The Young Ones Schooling The Elders
manager_roasts.roast_body: Renny's 'The Young Ones' showed mature nerve with 55 points to pocket Ksh. 83.33 on the podium.

manager_roasts.roast_title: Torque Dennis - 'DenniSkills' In The Heartbreak Hotel
manager_roasts.roast_body: Dennis brought pure skill with 52 points, but 'DenniSkills' missed out on the podium money by a razor-thin margin. High skill, zero shillings.

manager_roasts.roast_title: King Chris - The Painter Strokes A Neutral Canvas
manager_roasts.roast_body: King Chris entered with royal ambitions, but 'The_Painter..' painted a very beige mid-table portrait with 50 points.
Erick's 'mambaaa' didn't deliver the fatal bite promised, slithering into rank #5 with 50 points.

manager_roasts.roast_title: Benn Mwangi - Minimalist Name, Minimalist Points
manager_roasts.roast_body: With a team name as creatively minimal as 'Odysseus Reign', his 47-point tally was equally subdued at rank #7.

manager_roasts.roast_title: Bright Ottore - 'Phill Me In' Got Filled With Regret
manager_roasts.roast_body: Bright was anything but cheerful as 'Phill Me In FC' got thoroughly dismantled for 45 points at rank #8.

manager_roasts.roast_title: Marvin Owino - 'Don Bosco' In Urgent Need Of Prayers
manager_roasts.roast_body: The undisputed Clown of the Gameweek! Marvin's 'Don Bosco' crashed and burned with 36 points. Emergency pilgrimage to Don Bosco church advised.
Aron Mangati entered the league starting Gameweek 2 and was granted an official committee pardon for GW 1. Zero points recorded, zero contributions owed, and ready to battle from GW 2 onward!
